segments.ja: タイバーの一行が、収容区の外から入ってきます。入ってくる中心は、ヴィリー・タイバーです。ヴィリーは、戦士ではなく、言葉で国を動かす人として紹介されます。紹介の後ろに、一族の静かな女がいます。いる女の役割を、候補たちはまだ戦鎚とは呼びません。呼ばないまま、街は舞台と座席を組みます。組む仕事に、ガビは近い位置を望みます。望む位置が、彼女の次の点数です。
segments.en: The Tybur party comes in from outside the internment zone. The center that comes in is Willy Tybur. Willy is introduced not as a warrior but as a person who moves the country with words. Behind the introduction is a quiet woman of the family. The candidates do not yet call the woman's role the War Hammer. Without calling it, the town builds a stage and seats. Gabi wants a close position in the work of building. The position she wants is her next points.

segments.en: Magath says shortly why the Tybur power has not gone to war until now. The reason he says is that the Titan was hidden inside the family, and Marley's army could not use it freely. Willy now brings the power that was not used out onto the political table. The form he brings out is not yet a Titan. It is not. It is a speech on a stage. Pieck and Porco watch the preparation of the speech from a distance. The distance of watching is not trust. It is caution.

segments.en: Even during the festival preparation, Falco keeps going to Kruger's ward. The hand that goes there this time carries a small parcel, not a letter. The parcel looks like care for the man's wound. Under the care that can be seen, Kruger asks for one more visit. The person he asks for is Reiner. He wants Falco to bring Reiner to a quiet room like a basement. He says only that the reason he wants it concerns Gabi's future. The one sentence he says pushes Falco's door further.

segments.en: Gabi calls the stage as it is built an opportunity for Eldia. The opportunity she names is to show, in front of the world's guests, that they are useful. She tries to take Udo and Zofia to the place of showing as well. Falco does not stop the plan of taking them. The reason he does not stop it is that stopping would touch the talk of the letters. He puts the secret he does not want touched under a smile. Gabi receives the smile he puts as his usual lateness. The misunderstanding she receives protects him today.

segments.ja: ファルコは、ライナーに静かな部屋の案内をします。する案内は、負傷兵があなたに会いたがっている、です。会いたがっている名を、彼はクルーガーと言います。言う姓に、ライナーの足が一度止まります。止まる記憶は、島の記録にある同じ姓です。同じ姓を、彼は偶然かもしれないと思いながらついて行きます。ついて行く廊下は、祭りの音から外れています。外れた先が、扉の一つの部屋です。
segments.en: Falco guides Reiner to the quiet room. The guidance he gives is that a wounded soldier wants to see him. He says the name that wants to see him is Kruger. segments.en: Gabi takes a seat near the stage as an honor for the candidates. Udo and Zofia sit beside the seat she takes. The three who sit think Willy's talk will be a defense of Eldia. Falco, thinking otherwise, comes to the same row a little late. The face that comes is whiter than usual. He says the reason it is white is fatigue from the letters. Under the lie he says, there is the fact that he carried Reiner to the room. Gabi does not yet know the fact that is there. The row that does not know waits for the night of the festival.

segments.en: Leaving the room, Reiner cannot go straight back to his mother's house. The feet that cannot go back stop in an alley of the internment zone. Inside the head that stops is one sentence: Eren is here. The one sentence should be enough as a reason to stop the festival. He cannot immediately deliver to Magath the report that should be enough. The reason he cannot deliver it is that the moment he delivers it, he admits that all four of his years were a lie. The fear of being admitted is the weight of what was passed from hand to hand.

segments.en: Pieck notices that the flow of people in the town is not only the pleasure of a festival. The nose that notices is a nose that has done long scouting as the Cart. She shares the sense she has done, shortly, with Porco. The content she shares is that among the guests there is a smell of the island. The proof of that smell is not yet a name. It is not. Even so, the two of them look once at the passage under the stage. The passage they look at is dark. Magath's posting has not completely closed the dark passage.

segments.en: At night, Falco washes the hand that guided Reiner. The hand he washes will not come clean more than usual. The sense of not coming clean is guilt. The content of the guilt is not yet clear. It is not. Still not clear, he tells Gabi that tomorrow they will sit together. The promise he says is his last ordinary sentence. Beyond the ordinary sentence, Kruger is already about to close the role of the wounded soldier. Only Reiner, in this episode, knows the real name of the role that is about to close.

segments.en: What passed today was not only letters. It was not. From Falco's hand to Reiner's eyes, Eren himself was passed. Even after he was passed, the festival has not been cancelled. In the town where it has not, Willy finishes the script. The words he finished will be read tomorrow to the world's guests. Before they are read, Reiner cannot sleep. segments.en: The passage under the stage stays open through the night. Tomorrow's guests are not yet in the open dark.
